decisions.reason: Using the newly supplied authoritative document does not necessarily alter the approved copyediting passages or the existing editorial goal; preservation of the re-entered updates is already owned by the source Requirement.
The source decision does not mention or alter the requirement to exclude the unintended newline marker from the book title.
The image defects in message 126 are separate clauses already represented by a runtime failure; the source content-integrity modification does not change the candidate's rendering-quality values.
The replacement of the authoritative manuscript file does not change the cover count, trim size, preferred cover visual, or unresolved cover choice.
Nothing in the source modification changes or withdraws the existing publication attribution line.
The updated working document does not explicitly change the Chapter 18 subtitle and body-text formatting requirement.
Paragraph spacing is established independently by another clause in the same message and already has a matching Event; the source content-integrity modification adds no further spacing change.
The italic styling request is established independently by another clause in the same message and already has a matching Event; the authoritative-file change does not modify that style.

Resubmitting replacement pictures does not change the general facts that images are client-supplied and require suitability review, and the source content-integrity modification does not select a new image under this Requirement.
The source modification does not change chapter coverage, placement location, full-page presentation, image reference method, or the recorded Gifting Right image.
Changing the authoritative manuscript document does not alter the agreed guided KDP workflow or its assistance parameters.
The source decision does not change or remove the required back matter and author biography content.
